title: Awakened Skill Frontmatter
description: Validates the parsed YAML frontmatter object of an Awakened skill (plugins/<plugin>/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md). The description field is the auto-invocation trigger surface: skills fire on description matching, not on name recognition (N-2), so its floor is enforced here rather than left to review. The $id is an identifier only and is never fetched at runtime (HR-6).
$comment: R-4: the official Claude Code skill frontmatter field set is open-ended and is re-verified against the live docs at Phase 2 (SPEC section 0). Only the fields Awakened policy constrains are declared; additionalProperties stays true so a legitimate official field never blocks a merge. The tool-list delimiter for the string form (space vs comma) is an open assumption recorded in the synthesis ASSUMPTIONS register - templates use the list form, which is unambiguous either way, and this schema asserts no delimiter. 'hooks' is prohibited in skill frontmatter because a skill-level hook would sit outside the D-15 per-plugin budget, which is declared in plugin.json.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case skill name (N-3). Must equal the skill directory name; that cross-check is enforced by scripts/validate.

description.description: What the skill does and when it should trigger, in concrete situational terms. This is the auto-invocation surface (N-2): a name-length label with no trigger and no observable outcome is exactly the skill that never fires, which is why the floor is 40 characters.

allowed-tools.description: Tool allowlist. Prefer the list form; the string form's delimiter is verified against official docs at Phase 2.

disallowed-tools.description: Tool denylist. Same delimiter caveat as allowed-tools.

disable-model-invocation.description: When true the skill is invoked explicitly only, never auto-invoked by description matching.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Awakened components are MIT (D-08); the field exists for adapted upstream material carrying its own terms.

metadata.description: Free-form metadata bag for downstream tooling.
